objective: Create the minimal project foundation required before Android device automation. This goal establishes the Python package skeleton, typed configuration loading and validation, structured JSONL logging, startup health checks, project state bootstrap, README instructions, and deterministic unit tests. Do not implement device automation features in this goal.
scope: startup health check for Python plus optional adb/scrcpy/tesseract detection
unit tests for config, health and logging

steps.title: Bootstrap package and dependencies
steps.action: Create pyproject.toml and src/control_android package for Python 3.11+ with PyYAML runtime dependency and pytest dev dependency.

steps.title: Typed configuration
steps.action: Implement AppConfig and YAML loader with validation for positive timeouts, non-negative retry limit, and vision confidence in [0,1].

steps.title: Structured logging
steps.action: Implement append-only JSONL logging with timestamp, level, event and optional context.

steps.title: Startup health check
steps.action: Implement a CLI/module health check that requires Python 3.11+ and reports adb, scrcpy and tesseract as optional WARN when absent.

steps.title: Project state and docs
steps.action: Bootstrap .ai/project_state.json and README with install, health-check and test commands.

steps.title: Deterministic tests
steps.action: Add pytest coverage for valid/invalid config, optional-tool health behavior, and JSONL output parsing.

acceptance_criteria: python -m control_android.health exits 0 on a normal developer machine when optional Android tools are absent and reports those missing optional tools as WARN
JSONL logger emits valid parseable JSON containing timestamp, level and event
.ai/project_state.json exists and does not mark G00 DONE without test evidence
No out-of-scope Android automation module is added

preplan_review.request: Review this plan before source promotion. Challenge scope, architecture boundaries, testability, missing acceptance criteria, and any premature implementation. Return PASS only if it is implementation-ready without expanding beyond G00.
